bindings.manuscript_section: 3.1 Population, source semantics and conditional entry
bindings.claim_text: Freddie Mac longitudinal mortgage histories supply the empirical population. Facilities, not monthly rows, are the loan-level statistical units. Eligible risk intervals are consecutive monthly observations satisfying the frozen research event and ascertainment rules. The adverse endpoint is a research default proxy, not a certified institution-specific default definition.
